greeting: Tell me what went wrong, in your own words. Name the site if you can.
notListed: Comix Downloader only works on the sites listed on this page. If you'd like a site added, open an issue on GitHub and name it.
askError: What does the extension or the site show?
askAction: What were you doing when it happened?
askVersion: Let's write a report you can file. What version does the extension show at the bottom of its Settings tab? It looks like 5.0.0.
badVersion: That doesn't look like a version number. It's at the bottom of the Settings tab, like 5.0.0. Type it, or type "don't know".
askSeries: Paste the address of the series page you were on, or skip this.
report: Here's your report. The button opens GitHub with it filled in: you'll need a GitHub account, then press "Create". Nothing you typed here leaves this page until you open that link.

states.down: {site} is down right now, so the extension can't reach it either. There's nothing to fix on your side; try again once the page shows it working.
states.unknown: I couldn't load the latest check for {site}, so I'll go by what you tell me.

actions.label: Looking for the buttons on the site

errors.label: It asks me to pass a browser check
fixes: Open {site} in a normal tab and pass its check there. Then open the extension's Downloads tab and press Resume.
If it asks again right away, switch Pace to Gentle in Settings, wait a few minutes, and resume.

errors.label: An error with 403 or 429 in it
fixes: The site is refusing requests for a while. Switch Pace to Gentle in Settings, wait about ten minutes, then press Try missed chapters again in the Downloads tab.
Open {site} in a tab and check that you can read the chapter there yourself.

errors.label: It says the site isn't allowed yet
fixes: Open the extension's Sites tab and press Allow next to {site}, then accept the browser's prompt.
Reload the {site} tab afterwards so the buttons can appear.

errors.label: Nothing happens
fixes: Reload the {site} tab, then open the extension's This tab view and try from there.
Check the Downloads tab: a job may be waiting for you to pass a browser check or to resume.

errors.label: The file won't open or pages are missing
fixes: Download the chapter again; if pages failed, the Downloads tab offers Try missed chapters again.
If a CBZ won't open, try the same chapter as ZIP (File format in This tab) to see whether the reader app is the problem.

errors.label: Something else
fixes: Reload the {site} tab and try once more; sites change their pages now and then.
If it still fails, the next step writes a report with everything needed to look into it.
